mechanism: gate cancellation + SWAP-conjugation relabelling (SWAP^2 = I, SWAP G SWAP = G with wires exchanged)

rule.name: router_swap_pair_cancellation_by_swap_conjugation
rule.idea: Let SW_ab be one router SWAP block (BS(pi,0) plus its two compensating single-mode R's on a,b): SW_ab^2 = I exactly, and for any gate G on wires disjoint from {a,b}, SW_ab G SW_ab = G unchanged since conjugation by a permutation of tensor factors only relabels operators on the wires it swaps. For a 1-op gate on a or b, SW_ab G_a SW_ab = G_b (same gate, other mode). Scan the routed circuit for two SW_ab blocks on the same unordered mode pair with an intervening window where every gate is either disjoint from {a,b} or a single-wire gate on a or b (qubit gates automatically qualify since they never touch qumode wires). Delete both blocks and relabel a<->b on every gate in the window. This is exact: it never touches bare BS(pi,0) without its compensating R's (whose square alone is only the parity (-1)^{n_a+n_b}, not I), only whole router blocks. 2-op gates touching a or b inside the window block the rewrite for that pair (left for a topology-aware extension).
